_doc: Allowlist for the RLS policy guard at scripts/check_rls_policies.js. Every entry MUST include a real reason that survives review. The guard fails CI if anything outside this file goes permissive or RLS-off.

rls_disabled_tables.reason: Throwaway scratch table for verifying realtime broadcast wiring. Holds no real data. Migration 20260604000013_test_dummy.sql.
Sibling scratch table used by the realtime RLS smoke test (migration 20260604000014_test_rls.sql). Contains no real data; CI does not need to defend it.

permissive_policies.reason: Anon storefront analytics — insert-only event log used by the storefront grid to record view/add-to-cart events for funnel analysis. Append-only; admins read.

Reactions are visible to any participant of the conversation. Legacy policy from messenger v1; safe because participation is enforced on the parent messenger_messages SELECT policy and reactions only ever join through it.

Link previews are unfurled URLs (title, image, description). They contain no user-specific data; visible to all authenticated users so any participant who later sees the message can render the preview.
Stores the public-facing referral bonus amounts shown on /referrals and inside the agent dashboard. Single-row config table; no PII.
Public flat-rate shipping tiers shown on the checkout page and the public Shipping page. Anonymous quotes must work pre-login.
